## Council preview

- proposal-risk — Can the rollout fail under the stated traffic and rollback assumptions?
- recovery-defense — Which existing controls make the rollout safe, and what evidence would defeat that defense?

Format: Structured challenge — one proposal needs an objective attack and defense.

Both real members formed independent first views from the plan. One focused follow-up tests only the unresolved rollback claim. The synthesis preserves any conflict that evidence does not settle.
